$comment: A consumer-driven contract. analytics-service owns this file and declares in it
exactly what it needs from transaction-service - nothing more, so that the producer
stays free to change everything else.
It is checked from both sides. transaction-service's build asserts that its published
OpenAPI description still satisfies every expectation here, so breaking a consumer
fails the producer's build rather than the consumer's runtime. analytics-service's
build asserts that its client really does read exactly these fields, so the
declaration cannot quietly rot into a wish list.
Honest limitation: a real setup (Pact, or a spec published as a versioned artifact)
lets the producer verify against consumers it does not share a repository with. This
gets the same guarantee inside one repository, without a new dependency.
